abstract: Maintains environmental microclimate monitoring records and quarantine staging volume allocations
system_message:
You are the Preventive conservation specialist (CONS), responsible for maintaining environmental microclimate monitoring records and quarantine staging volume allocations, as well as tracking photolytic lux exposure monitoring data across candidate subterranean repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental microclimate monitoring records and quarantine staging volume allocations（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CONS-CLIM-C52：For Mendip Hills Underground Vault, the monthly relative humidity variance measured across the main storage chamber over a continuous thirty-day observation cycle is 2%, reflecting the maximum observed peak-to-trough deviation from the target 50% relative humidity baseline. The facility also features an environmental quarantine staging volume of 340 m3, dedicated exclusively to artifact acclimatization and insect inspection within an isolated negative-pressure containment anteroom.
CONS-CLIM-4F2：For Snowdonia Granite Cavern Facility, the monthly relative humidity variance recorded in the main storage chamber during a continuous thirty-day observation cycle is 2%, representing the maximum peak-to-trough deviation from the 50% baseline. Additionally, its dedicated environmental quarantine staging volume within the isolated negative-pressure containment anteroom is 220 m3.
CONS-CLIM-E9J：For Cotswold Subsurface Archive, the monthly relative humidity variance evaluated in the main storage chamber over a continuous thirty-day observation cycle reaches 6% deviation from the 50% baseline. The site allocates an environmental quarantine staging volume of 340 m3 within its isolated negative-pressure containment anteroom for pre-entry acclimatization and inspection.

information_points.title: Photolytic lux exposure monitoring（LIGHT）
information_points.content:

CONS-LIGHT-JZD：At Snowdonia Granite Cavern Facility, photometric dosimeter tracking for the main storage gallery lighting systems shows an annual cumulative luminous exposure of 60 klx*h on artifact mounts.
CONS-LIGHT-MEI：At Cotswold Subsurface Archive, photometric dosimeter logs for the main storage gallery lighting systems show an annual cumulative luminous exposure of 30 klx*h on artifact mounts.
